title: activitypub/inbound.rs: reqwest::Client created per HTTP signature verification
description:
Why this issue exists: fetch_public_key in crates/mail/src/activitypub/inbound.rs calls reqwest::Client::new() for every incoming ActivityPub activity that requires signature verification. reqwest::Client internally manages a connection pool; creating a new one per call discards all pooled connections and incurs unnecessary TLS handshake overhead on every verification.

What needs to be done: Share a single reqwest::Client instance across verifications, injected via AppState or constructed once in a LazyLock.
